# FilamentCraft

> A Shopify-style, drag-and-drop visual website builder for Filament v4 & v5.

FilamentCraft is a commercial Filament plugin that adds a visual page builder to any Filament panel: drag-and-drop sections, a live iframe preview, revisioned templates with undo/redo, user-facing themes (colors, typography, ~1,900 fonts, 22-token color schemes), and multi-tenant-ready public routing. Sites belong to any host model via a polymorphic owner morph — no tenancy package required.
